_comment_for_humans: Eagle3 DRAFT model config for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. The draft is a 1-layer Llama (NOT DeepSeek-V4 architecture) — same convention as deepseek-v3-671b-eagle3.json and deepseek-v3.2-eagle3.json. Aux hidden state layer ids [1, 21, 41] are slot proposals for the V4-Flash 43-layer trunk; see experiments/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/architecture-notes.md 'Eagle3 aux capture layer slots' for the rationale (layer 1 = window-only, layer 21 = CSA mid-network, layer 41 = CSA late-network). hidden_size=4096 matches V4-Flash's dim. intermediate_size=16384 = 4 * hidden_size (standard Llama default). num_attention_heads=32 = V4's 64 / 2 (proportional reduction for the draft); num_key_value_heads=8 (GQA standard for Eagle3 drafts). max_position_embeddings=1048576 matches V4's 1M context. bos/eos/pad token ids match V4's tokenizer_config.json (0/1/1).
